title: Telegram Thinking Status Screenshots
summary: User-uploaded real Telegram DM screenshots with session ID and auth/email redacted. Baseline shows /think default followed by /status reporting Think: off; updated local build shows /think default followed by /status reporting Think: medium. These screenshots cover the default-thinking status behavior, not a new live xhigh rerun.

baseline.expected: /think default should report the configured provider default, not off

candidate.expected: /think default reports Think: medium in Telegram status
